User: Can you look at our invoice-sync worker? It keeps flooding the logs.
Assistant: Happy to help. What should the logging look like?
User: In general, when the service runs in prod, I prefer WARN-level logging. Also, always give every Python function a one-line docstring.
Assistant: Noted: WARN-level logging in prod, and a one-line docstring on every function.
User: Great. I'll send over the actual config later.

User: Different topic: I'm setting up the notification service this afternoon.
Assistant: Sure. Anything about how you like it configured?
User: I prefer DEBUG-level logging by default. That way I can trace every request.
Assistant: Understood, DEBUG-level logging by default.
User: Thanks, that's all for now.
